export.title: SVG Export
export.body: All charts are generated as scalable SVG — resize them to any resolution without quality loss for presentations or print.

language.title: Natural Language Input
language.body: No data upload, no formatting required. Just describe what you want to visualise in plain English.

items.business: Creating data charts for business presentations and reports
items.processes: Visualising processes and workflows as flowcharts
items.concepts: Mapping relationships between concepts as mind maps
items.comparison: Building comparison tables for product or feature analysis
items.timeline: Generating quick timeline graphics for project overviews

items.numbers: Include specific numbers for data charts: 'Q1 $50k, Q2 $75k, Q3 $60k' produces a more accurate bar chart than a vague description.
items.steps: For flowcharts, describe the steps sequentially: 'User visits page → clicks button → form appears → submits → confirmation shown.'
items.autoDetect: Use 'Auto-Detect' for your first attempt — then switch to a specific type if the result isn't what you expected.
items.edit: SVGs can be opened in Figma, Illustrator, or any vector editor for further customisation.

types.question: What chart types can it create?
types.answer: Bar charts, pie charts, line charts, flowcharts, mind maps, timelines, and comparisons. Pick a type explicitly or use Auto-Detect and the AI will choose the best fit for your data.

how.question: How does the AI turn my text into a chart?
how.answer: The AI reads your description, extracts the labels, values, and structure into a JSON spec, and then the chart is drawn deterministically from that spec — so text and numbers render crisply, not as AI-generated imagery.

input.question: What input works best?
input.answer: Concrete data in plain text, e.g. "Sales: Q1 120, Q2 150, Q3 90" or a list of steps for a flowchart. Vague descriptions force the AI to invent numbers.

download.question: How do I download the result?
download.answer: Charts are generated as SVG, which you can download directly. SVG scales to any size without losing quality and can be opened in browsers and design tools.

cost.question: How much does a chart cost?
cost.answer: 2 image tokens per generation. If generation fails, the tokens are refunded automatically.
